retrievalProfile.description: A square instant-film aesthetic featuring a faded, low-contrast family portrait with a white border, date stamp, and cursive bottom-margin text.
triggerTerms: instant film border with date stamp
excludeWhen: clean minimalist digital layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square-format instant photograph with a thick white border, featuring a slightly desaturated and grainy image of a mother and child at a birthday party, complete with a physical cutout banner and handwritten notes on the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a square frame
Text banner arcing over the subjects' heads
Handwritten script balanced against a mechanical date stamp
Muted, warm color palette against a stark white border
coreInvariants: Square image aspect ratio within a rectangular white border
Visible film grain and low dynamic range
Date stamp located in the bottom-left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mother and child are centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the image area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's white birthday hat serves as the central vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subjects upward to the arched banner, then down to the handwritten text on the border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant empty wall space above the banner and around the subjects within the photo area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted off-white and beige (background and border)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal/Blue (mother's shirt) providing the primary color pop
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with raised blacks, typical of aged instant film.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Varies between blocky cutouts and fluid cursive
letterConstructionRules: Banner letters are irregular, blocky, and appear to be cut from different materials
Bottom text is a continuous, thin-stroke cursive script with high slant
Date stamp uses a monospaced, mechanical sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Banner 'A' and 'E' have heavy, uneven strokes
Cursive 'H' and 'C' have exaggerated, sweeping flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between physical, chunky banner letters and elegant, thin-line handwriting.

preserve: Cursive script on the bottom border

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the DIY feel of the birthday banner
Mimics the handwritten note on the photo border

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a faded, grainy 1980s square photo of a mother holding a child in a party setting, featuring a teal shirt and a white party hat, framed by a thick white polaroid border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add an arched banner of multi-colored cutout letters above the subjects. Place a small mechanical date stamp in the bottom-left corner and a thin, flowing cursive script across the bottom white margin.

verificationChecks: Is the image square within a rectangular border?
Is the date stamp in the bottom-left corner?
Does the bottom text look like handwriting?

postGenerationChecks: Check for square aspect ratio of the inner photo
Ensure the white border is wider at the bottom
Verify the 'faded' look of the colors
Confirm the text is not perfectly aligned
recipe.reuseFormula: Square photo + thick white border + arched cutout banner + bottom-margin script = Nostalgic Polaroid Aesthetic
